summary: Frontend E2E for iteration 6: booking shortcut URL, PropertyDetailPage calendar dark/light green range, offline payments (cash + bank), Admin Pagamenti tab, Lead Chat 'Doc' column. One CRITICAL bug found and fixed in BookingShortcut.js (wrong calculate-price endpoint). All other flows pass.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent. /app/frontend/src/pages/BookingShortcut.js was calling POST /api/properties/{property.id}/calculate-price (404 Not Found). Backend exposes POST /api/properties/calculate-price expecting property_id in body. Result: every shortcut URL hit the catch branch, fired 'Impossibile trovare la casa o calcolare il prezzo' toast and redirected guest to /properties — feature was 100% broken before fix. Patched to call the correct endpoint with property_id in payload.

action_items: Verify the BookingShortcut.js fix on the next iteration (already applied by test agent: posts to /api/properties/calculate-price with property_id in body).

Optional: align dark-green token with the spec hsl(145 55% 28%). Tailwind currently emits green-800 (rgb 22,101,52 ≈ hsl 142 64% 24%) on the range edges. Visually correct (dark green) but not the exact requested hue.
Optional: BookingShortcut could surface a more descriptive error if the underlying API call fails (e.g. show backend message instead of generic toast).

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 features (shortcut, calendar dark-green range, offline payments + Admin Pagamenti tab) verified working after the BookingShortcut endpoint fix. Lead Chat 'Doc' column header confirmed present in admin table headers list. Backend was NOT re-tested this iteration because request was frontend-only and no backend code was touched.
rca of the issue: BookingShortcut.js used /api/properties/{id}/calculate-price (resource-style URL with id in path), but the FastAPI route is defined as POST /api/properties/calculate-price with PriceCalculation body containing property_id. The misrouted POST returned 404 Not Found, the try/catch surfaced a generic toast, and useEffect navigated the user to /properties — making the shortcut feature unusable. Fix: call the existing canonical route with property_id in the JSON body, matching PropertyDetailPage.js. Reproduction (pre-fix): open /prenota/villa-smeraldo?checkin=2026-07-05&checkout=2026-07-08&guests=4 → page bounces to /properties with red toast. Post-fix: BookingPage renders with prefilled summary (3 notti, 4 ospiti, €2280).
